title.narrative: Transparency International BiH, Core support II phase
Transparency International BiH, Kärnstöd II fas

description.narrative:
Core support to TI BiH strategic activities.
TI BiH's overall objective in its strategy for the ten­year period is to be a country where Power is held to account, for the common good. To achieve the overall objective of the strategy, TI BiH developed general objectives: 1) Checks and balances, 2) Law enforcement; 3) Social oversight. Based on this, TI BiH has identified four specific objectives: 1)Protection of public resources; 2) Secure integrity in politics; 3) Enforce laws and sanction; 4) Defend civil society and promote integrity. The strategy and proposal created by TI BiH provide a detailed explanation of the expected results and the actions. Also, the operationalization of the intervention would focus on the two main streams of change: a) Behavior change: The ultimate aim is that individuals, communities, civil society organizations, and social movements act systematically to promote and demand good governance and, in that way, defend their interests by political means; b) Policy and institutional change: The ultimate aim is to ensure that institutions, governments, the public sector, political parties, and businesses have all the necessary mechanisms, policies, or laws in place to redress and prevent corruption, sanction corrupt behavior, and promote good governance.

Kärnstöd till TI BiH:s strategiska aktiviteter.
TI BiH:s övergripande mål i sin strategi för tioårsperioden är att vara ett land där Makten ställs till svars, för det gemensamma bästa. För att uppnå det övergripande målet för strategin utvecklade TI BiH allmänna mål: 1) kontroller och avvägningar, 2) brottsbekämpning 3) social tillsyn. Baserat på detta har TI BiH identifierat fyra specifika mål: 1) Skydd av offentliga resurser 2) Säkra integritet i politiken 3) Genomdriva lagar och sanktioner; Försvara det civila samhället och främja integritet. Strategin och förslaget skapat av TI BiH ger en detaljerad förklaring av de förväntade resultaten och åtgärderna. Operationaliseringen av insatsen skulle också fokusera på de två huvudsakliga förändringsströmmar: a) Beteendeförändring: Det yttersta målet är att individer, samhällen, civila samhällsorganisationer och sociala rörelser agerar systematiskt för att främja och kräva gott styre och på det sättet försvara sina intressen genom politiska medel; b) Policy och institutionell förändring: Det yttersta målet är att säkerställa att institutioner, regeringar, den offentliga sektorn, politiska partier och företag har allt nödvändiga mekanismer, policyer eller lagar på plats för att åtgärda och förebygga korruption, sanktionera korrupt beteende och främja god förvaltning.

title.narrative: Amandment no.1 to the Agrement with TI BiH
Arrangement on delegated cooperation with Denmark

description.narrative: The results presented below correspond to the specific objectives defined by the strategy of TI. 1. Protection of public resources The increasing number of public enterprises failing to conduct public procurement procedures has raised concern. TI BiH filed several criminal complaints, including the one against the prosecutorial office of Canton Sarajevo for failing to act on corruption cases. Together with acoalition of NGOs, TI have launched the "Accountability Platform". This initiative aims to jointly monitor institutional accountability, public officials, and political parties, support anticorruption reforms, and enhance integrity mechanisms. Also, as a part of the Western Balkans China Policy Team, TI has developed a policy memo to enhance transparency and accountability in contracts with Chinese companies. TI BiH has continued its activities in the field of natural resource protection. After six years of efforts, the Livno City Council canceled the approval for granting a concession for the exploitation and exploration of water. This decision represents a significant step toward protection of the water sources. 2. Secure integrity in politics TI BiH conducted a comprehensive monitoring of political entities in BiH for the 2024 local elections. The monitoring revealed that political parties spent around 10.8 million KM on billboards, media advertisements, and rallies, and over 2,570 instances of public resource misuse were recorded. Based on its work, the Central Election Commission imposed 18 sanctions, totaling 115,500 KM. TI BiH and the organization Vasa prava BiH have been working on the development of an online tool for the automatic generation of requests for freedom of information. Once launched, this tool will streamline the process of requesting public information, empowering citizens and organizations to hold public institutions accountable and ensuring more transparency in government activities. 3. Enforce laws and sanctions TI BiH's monitoring of public enterprises, public institutions, and concessions resulted in 21 lawsuits and one request for an extraordinary review of a judicial decision. Out of the 13 rulings, 12 were in favor of TI BiH, while one was dismissive. A comparative analysis was conducted with TI Czech Republic, analyzing the new Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorist Activities in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The Law on the Prevention of Conflict of Interest in Institutions at the level of BiH was adopted on March 8, 2024, but TI BiH pointed out that the lawmaking process had not adhered to basic international standards. TI BiH has actively participated in the development of the new AntiCorruption Strategy for Bosnia and Herzegovina for 20242028, aiming to address corruption issues, enhance transparency, and promote necessary institutional reforms. 4. Defending civil society and promoting integrity The new National Integrity System Study 2023 was presented and promoted, highlighting key findings that were further disseminated through social media channels. An extensive review of each sector was carried out in order to gain a precise insight into the way in which key institutions fight against corruption. TI BiH's Center for Legal Assistance received 1,694 calls for reporting corruption cases and initiated 391 cases. Several criminal charges were filed. TI BiH also initiated 32 administrative disputes related to the right of access to information, with 18 resolved in favor of the organization. Following the complaints filed by TI BiH regarding human rights violations, the Ombudsman Institution for Human Rights issued 4 recommendations.
